title: Pacheedaht Campground

services.name: Campsite
services.desc: Nestled between two rivers and stretching along a mile of driftwood-strewn beach, Pacheedaht Campground offers an unforgettable west coast camping experience.With beachfront sites, riverside nooks, and forested hideaways, there’s a spot for every camper to unwind and reconnect with nature. Whether you’re here to fish, paddle, hike nearby trails, or simply enjoy the soothing sound of the waves, our campground invites you to slow down and appreciate the beauty of this rugged coastline. Open year-round, Pacheedaht Campground welcomes all who respect the land.Sites can be booked up to 90 days in advance.
